preconditions.description: The length of the string s is between 1 and 10^5.
The value of k is between 1 and the length of s.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: All characters in s are lowercase letters.

postconditions.description: The length of the longest substring is non-negative.

postconditions.expression: exists(substring in substrings(s) | all(char in substring for char in set(substring)) and all(substring.count(char) >= k for char in set(substring)))
postconditions.description: There exists a substring T of s such that every character in T appears no less than k times.

postconditions.expression: all(substring in substrings(s) | not all(char in substring for char in set(substring)) or all(substring.count(char) >= k for char in set(substring)) or len(substring) < return_value)
postconditions.description: For every substring of s, if not all characters in the substring appear no less than k times, then its length is less than the length of the longest substring T.
